review_scope: Accept only the immediate/waiting/FIFO-dequeue success trace and self-contained repeat slice. Three scenarios bind two of the seventeen owner requirements; this is not owner-family completeness or Go replacement proof.

required_tuples.rationale: An idle job enters the running slot directly, broadcasts its matching successful task start/finish, and emits no queued transition on any tested authenticated or anonymous socket.

Synchronous batch admission fills one slot and enqueues two waiters. Each socket has the exact source-defined trace: admin-only true admissions; FIFO false dequeue after predecessor finish and before own start for every authenticated audience, including inaccessible/revoked-library users; no anonymous task or queue events. Consumed payload keys have exact spelling, string IDs and non-null booleans.

The scenario runs two successful batches itself, rotating item order for the second admission. Both independent socket traces distinguish the new immediate item from FIFO waiters without stale IDs, missing or duplicated transitions.
